title: Sundubu-jjigae (spicy silken tofu stew with egg)
steps: Wash the rice and cook it with 130 ml water for 12 minutes.
Chop the onion and garlic and fry with the kimchi in the sesame oil for 3 minutes, then stir in the gochujang and chilli flakes.
Add the stock and the sliced courgette and mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the silken tofu in large spoonfuls and the prawns and let them heat through for 3 minutes.
Crack in the eggs, let them set for 2 minutes, sprinkle with spring onion and serve with rice.
